scope: Synthetic electrical verification against native PyBaMM Thevenin and closed-form RC solutions; not experimental or thermal validation
temperature_scope: All electrical coefficients are independent of temperature. Studio runs isothermally. PyBaMM's separate jig thermal state is not compared or used as battery temperature evidence.
heat_scope: PyBaMM RC heat is current times overpotential; Studio separately accounts for RC resistor dissipation and effective capacitor storage. No equivalence of these heat interpretations is asserted.
